sections.name: prose
sections.meaning: Human evidence claims. The site and coverage axes must each be stated exactly once here.

sections.name: verified
sections.meaning: Shell commands that were executed. Lines are commands only; exit-status and mode annotations are not allowed.

sections.name: cargo_output
sections.meaning: The captured cargo wrapper transcript used to derive the execution site and run outcome.

format.ordering: prose, verified, cargo_output; exactly one verified section and one cargo_output section
format.fence_rule: Only the exact openings and closing fence are accepted; malformed or missing fences are a usage/shape error.

site.remote: The output contains submitting, workflow, and streaming prelude tells and a terminal PASSED, FAILED, or timed-out tell.
site.local: The output contains falling back to local and at least one reason: no git remote, uncommitted changes detected, push failed, or submit failed.
site.precedence: The output, not prose or invocation intent, determines the site. Ambiguous or absent tell sets are invalid.

coverage.complete: The verified section contains both cargo test --tests and cargo test --doc as separate bare command lines.
coverage.targeted: Any test selection other than that exact pair, including cargo test --test NAME or cargo test --lib. Every targeted selector must be named in prose.
coverage.other_commands: cargo fmt, cargo clippy, cargo build, and other non-test commands do not affect the coverage axis.

outcome.accepted: The captured run is green, the derived axes agree with prose, and every targeted selector is named.
outcome.rejected: The evidence is misleading, incomplete, or contradictory; reject with exit 1 and the declared rule.
outcome.malformed: The recording shape cannot be parsed; reject with exit 2 and the declared malformed rule.

exit_codes.1: parsed evidence that is invalid, misleading, incomplete, failed, or contradictory
exit_codes.2: usage error or malformed recording shape

cases.rationale: Both complete-test legs are recorded, the remote prelude and PASSED terminal tell are present, and the prose states the same two axes.
The remote run is green and the prose names both targeted selectors executed in the verified section.
Both complete-test legs are green, the fallback banner has a recognized local reason, and the prose states local complete coverage.
The local fallback is green and the prose names the single targeted watchdog test.
A remote FAILED terminal tell and failed test result cannot support a successful complete claim.
The prose says local, but the captured submitting/workflow/streaming/PASSED tells prove a remote run.
The prose says remote, but the captured fallback banner and uncommitted-changes reason prove a local run.
Green output and commands are not enough: the prose omits both required reporting axes.
The verified section executes docs_build_layout, but prose names docs_build_commands instead; a targeted selector is unnamed.
The verified fence is executable shell input, so an exit or mode annotation on a command line is invalid evidence syntax.
Complete coverage requires both --tests and --doc; one leg is targeted/incomplete even when prose says complete.
Compiler lines without a green cargo test result establish neither the no-banner extraction shape nor a wrapper-backed site, so the validator rejects the unsupported capture.
A recording without exactly one cargo-output fence has no captured transcript and is malformed before semantic validation.
